rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for a school attended after primary school and before university.

example.english: My younger sister is starting secondary school this year and still isn't used to getting up so early.
example.traditional: 我妹今年升中學，仲未習慣朝早咁早起身。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui6 gam1 nin4 sing1 zung1 hok6 zung6 mei6 zaap6 gwaan3 ziu1 zou2 gam3 zou2 hei2 san1
